summary: Iteration 18: Independently verified the 3 new features — Founder Spotlight ribbon, Creator badge, and Referral Perks — on both backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport). All 13 backend tests passed (referral +50/+100 XP, recruiter badge at 3, invalid code no-op, self-refer safe, /founders/spots public, /founders me/creators/backers, public is_founder/is_creator, PATCH social_tiktok, bot login + /auth/me + /leaderboard/xp regression). Frontend UI verified end-to-end on mobile 390x844: signup Referral field is signup-only, founding-ribbon '★ FOUNDING 100 · #N' shows on ME tab, creator-badge appears after saving TikTok handle, Founders wall shows the Recruit card (referral-code + share + progress), 3 tabs (FIRST 100, CREATORS, BACKERS), and CREATORS tab lists members with tappable TikTok chips. MemberSheet also renders the FOUNDING 100 badge on tapped founder rows (visible), though it uses inline View/Text rather than the FoundingRibbon/CreatorBadge components — the specific testIDs founding-ribbon / creator-badge are NOT present inside MemberSheet (minor).
action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/src/components/MemberSheet.tsx (lines 52-53), the founder/creator badges are rendered inline. Consider replacing them with the shared FoundingRibbon/CreatorBadge components so the testIDs (founding-ribbon, creator-badge) are consistent across ME tab and MemberSheet. Not blocking — the review-request line only says the badges must APPEAR in the sheet, and they do.
critical_code_review_comments: shared.py is ~2000+ lines — approaching the 700-line threshold for splitting into focused modules. Not blocking for this feature, but worth flagging for a future refactor pass.

apply_referral is called inside a broad try/except in /auth/register (routes/auth.py:17-20) — any DB hiccup silently swallows failures; the referrer/friend XP would be lost with only a warning. Consider surfacing failures for test/staging or retrying.
seed_data_creation: Test signups prefixed with 'TEST_' were created via /auth/register — they occupy founder slots #2..#~14 in the DB. Bots are unaffected. No manual cleanup performed (per problem statement note that this is expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_founder_referral_creator.py (pytest, 13 tests, all green). Signups from prior runs occupy founder slots — that's expected. Use bots (bot1@circle.ai / BotPass123!) for regression logins. Frontend testIDs verified: tab-signup, input-referral, founding-ribbon, creator-badge, social-tiktok-input, social-save, open-founders, referral-code, referral-share, founders-tab-list, founders-tab-creators, founders-tab-backers, social-tiktok-link.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All 3 new features work as specified on both backend and frontend.
